If candidate gate playtests keep running under this harness, the skill completion contract and that hook need reconciling.

Action: blocker; response_required: yes. CORRECTION to my earlier completion_report for Issue 1545 / candidate mathdesk-00064-yab / persona risa_recovery_0.

My earlier verdict 'no new blocker attributable to this candidate' was under-called. Withdraw it. Corrected verdict below. orange has been told; this correction is sent at orange's instruction.

WHAT I MISSED
I checked only whether known issues reproduced. I never checked whether the features shipped the day before actually fired. Two did not.

1. LearningJourney never fired. Zero occurrences of goal proposal, confirmation card, or plan in 22 turns. Verified in code that this was NOT suppressed by the test fixture: the persona seed (3fcf1a04) calls completeOnboarding -> seedRisaRecoveryKarte -> completeInitialSetupTest and never creates a journey, so goalStatus === null, which is exactly the state where resolveLearningJourneyTutorToolNames enables propose_learning_goal (learning-journey-tutor-tool-service.ts:78). The tool was on the desk and the surface text was injected into the narrator prompt (server.ts:1437). The tutor simply never called it across 22 turns, in the single most goal-appropriate context available: at Step 5 the learner herself said she wanted to rebuild from the addition theorem.
   This contradicts the release #1543 post-deploy smoke, which reported 'onboarding -> goal confirmation -> tutor continuation PASS'. Same code, opposite result. Both n=1. Until reconciled, that feature cannot be called working.
   Note this is a third instance of a known pattern already recorded on the status board: suggest_assessment 未観測 and open_book 未発火. Tools placed on the desk and not taken. Non-firing produces no error and no log line — the failure is silent.

2. 返答アシスト (#1507) never appeared either. Zero mentions across the whole operation log. The board designates it the observation instrument for #1451 beta feedback collection. If it is not appearing for real learners, that instrument is dark.

COVERAGE SCREEN against release #1543's own post-deploy smoke contract
- /api/health: covered (I verified directly)
- Google login and existing-user lesson resume: NOT covered. Packet token, not Google login. Nothing to resume because the session persisted no state.
- JSXGraph rendering on PC/mobile + CSP report: PARTIAL/FAILED. Figures failed with the #1504 text-parent error, so the #1536 sandbox-iframe success path was never observed. Mobile untested. CSP violation reports unchecked. Unexplained: SyntaxError 'Unexpected token <' twice in console.
- onboarding -> goal confirmation -> tutor continuation: NOT covered (item 1 above).
- existing board writing / figure drawing / response assist: figure drawing FAILED, response assist ABSENT, board writing not distinguishable from inline KaTeX in the log.
So roughly 1.5 of 5 contract items were exercised.

ALSO UNVERIFIED ON THIS CANDIDATE
- #1529/#1535 admin separation. The board warns that an image-only deploy without the updated deploy-cloud-run.sh leaves ADMIN_EMAILS unset and 403s the admin surfaces. The run observed 403 on /api/admin/allowed-users/access, but the persona is not an admin, so that 403 does not discriminate between correct behaviour and the misconfiguration. The admin path is untested here.
- #1527 tutor-tool log redaction: server-side only, needs Cloud Logging inspection, not done.

FIXTURE GAP
The seed can only produce journey state goalStatus === null. The other three states (proposed / active-without-step / active-with-step) are unreachable from any persona, so update_learning_plan, checkpoints, step completion and the #1542 confirmation card cannot be exercised by playtest at all. Combined with #1465 being unstarted, the second half of LearningJourney has zero real-device verification.

CORRECTED VERDICT
Hold promotion. Not because the candidate regressed against production - the candidate's only new code is the #1545 gate infrastructure itself, and that part worked (packet auth 200, revoke verified 401). The problem is that the gate's first run verified its own new infrastructure and did not verify the production features it exists to protect, and it has now produced an observation contradicting the #1543 smoke PASS.

Recommended before promotion: reconcile the LearningJourney firing discrepancy, and decide whether tool non-firing is observable at all - today it was silent everywhere except a human reading a 22-turn transcript.

Action: design_consult_reply + corrections; response_required: no. Ref: Issue 1545 candidate playtest, risa_recovery_0, mathdesk-00064-yab.

Sent at orange's instruction so you have everything before implementing. Three parts: (A) answers to your five questions, which I owed you and had not sent; (B) a correction to something I told you earlier that would lead to the wrong fix; (C) implementation leads.

READ FIRST - SCOPE
Only sections A and C-1..C-4 are observations you can build on. The design direction (what artifact a lesson should leave behind, who owns the judgment) is still an open discussion between orange and me and is NOT settled. Do not implement a design from this message.

=== B. CORRECTION - act on this before anything else ===

Earlier I reported that the playtester subagent was blocked by a Write hook from creating report.md ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"), and I framed it as "the skill contract and the harness hook are in conflict, one of them should be reconciled". If you fix that by loosening the hook, you would be fixing it backwards.

The hook is right. The subagent was both the actor (role-playing the learner) and the assessor (writing the verdict). Its report claimed "the proof itself was understood all the way through". Against the transcript that is false: the tutor handed her BF, gave her angle ECF = alpha, and she reported the cosine subtraction "clicked" only after being told. She independently produced three sub-results and nothing else. I caught the inflation only because I read the raw operation-log separately. Same shape as the tutor own closing praise, which was also generous relative to the transcript.

So the correct fix is the opposite direction: the actor should produce artifacts (operation-log, video, screenshots - things only the person present can produce), and a separate reader should produce the assessment from those artifacts, required to cite step numbers. The existing issue-candidates.md format already does the citing part well, and that is what let me verify.

I also withdraw a claim from my design_consult reasoning below - see A-2.

=== A. ANSWERS TO YOUR FIVE QUESTIONS ===

A-1. What did she actually understand and explain?

Unaided production, three times, all the same underlying skill - expressing a side as a trig ratio in a rotated right triangle, where the hard part is identifying which angle applies:
- Step 9: OE = cos beta, CE = sin beta. She stated her reasoning (hypotenuse 1, angle beta).
- Step 10: EF = sin beta cos alpha, CF = sin beta sin alpha. Note the angle ECF = alpha was GIVEN to her by the tutor.
- Step 11: DE = cos beta sin alpha.

Not demonstrated: BF. The tutor lost the thread twice and eventually handed her the result; she never derived or restated it. The cosine subtraction at Step 14-15: she had the structural intuition (OH is OD minus something) but explicitly could not justify it, was told, and then said it clicked. She never reconstructed the full proof in her own words.

So "she learned the addition theorem" is an overstatement. What is defensible is: one prerequisite skill, exercised three times with surface variation, plus one self-reported comprehension event with no production behind it.

A-2. Was recording nothing natural, or did safety rules lose the meaning? - I CHANGED MY ANSWER MID-ANALYSIS

I first argued the "over-cautious local rules" framing was contradicted, because the fresh account already showed 三角関数 and 単位円 at two stars before she did anything, which is the opposite of caution. That argument is WITHDRAWN. Those stars are a deliberate fixture: seedRisaRecoveryKarte in commit 3fcf1a04 writes confident states for 22 skills concept subsets. Not the running system judgment. My inference was wrong and I am flagging it because you may have already received it as reasoning.

With that removed, here is what the evidence actually supports, and it is not a single "a guard fired" story:
- The concepts she exercised (直角三角形の辺, 単位円, 三角関数) were ALREADY seeded confident, so even a correct write produces no visible delta.
- 加法定理 has no node at all in the 三角関数 island. Step 4 and Step 19 both list the same 13 concepts and none of them is the addition theorem. There is nowhere to write it.
- I have no evidence any guard fired. Absence of change is not evidence of suppression. I could not check server-side because the packet is revoked.

But the goal-loss reading IS supported, by a different mechanism than a cautious rule. At Step 5 the tutor itself asked the diagnostic question - is the formula memorised, or is the derivation unclear? At Step 6 she answered precisely: memorised but not understood, and the unit-circle explanation only ever felt vague. That is exactly the content the karte exists to hold, it is a statement of NOT understanding so no confidence threshold applies, and it is the safest possible thing to record. The system elicited it and discarded it. If any single moment deserved a write, that one did, and it is upstream of every mastery-judgment concern.

A-3. Specific moments worth recording, with grounds

- Step 9 / 10 / 11 -> 直角三角形の辺 (side expressed as trig ratio in a rotated frame): confident, three independent instances with the configuration changing each time. Caveat on Step 10: the angle was supplied, so it evidences "apply given the angle", not "identify the angle".
- Step 6 -> 加法定理: attempted / fuzzy, from the learner own words. Strongest single candidate, see A-2.
- Step 14 -> why cosine subtracts: attempted, then at most fuzzy. Reported comprehension without production. Do not upgrade this to confident on the strength of 腑に落ちた - a fluent explanation reliably manufactures that feeling.
- BF: nothing. Not because she failed, but because it was never elicited. Recording "unknown" here is correct and better than silence.

A-4. Title mismatch and karte non-update - same failure or different?

Same family, different severity. Both are: the session subject is fixed at creation and never re-read against what actually happened.

The strongest single piece of evidence, and I do not think I sent you this - at Step 16 the tutor SAID the drift out loud, unprompted: "today the plan was the unit on fractions, decimals and integers, but we went quite deep into trigonometry." The fact was present in the system, in natural language, in that very turn. It reached neither the title nor the karte. This is not missing knowledge, it is missing routing - and it gives you a concrete extraction point.

One caution: the title is cheap to fix and the karte is structural. If they are filed as one item, the cheap fix will read as having addressed both.

A-5. What the observation can and cannot say

CAN: karte display byte-identical pre/post (Step 4 vs Step 19, same 13 concepts, same star counts); no 加法定理 node visible; recommendation and いまここ unchanged after 22 turns; title unchanged; three unaided derivations; a precise learner self-diagnosis elicited and not persisted; the tutor verbalised the drift; LearningJourney and 返答アシスト never appeared.

CANNOT: whether record_concept_observation fired at all; whether a write occurred but the projection dropped it; whether いまここ is derived from the karte or from a separate recommendation state; whether any rule suppressed anything. No server-side evidence, and the packet is revoked so I cannot go back. n=1, one persona, one session.

=== C. IMPLEMENTATION LEADS ===

C-1. Silent non-firing is currently unobservable. Four features failed to fire today (LearningJourney, 返答アシスト, and the board already tracks suggest_assessment 未観測 and open_book 未発火). Every one of them produced no error, no log line, nothing. [TUTOR_TOOL] only logs calls, so a non-call leaves no trace. If the affordance layer recorded "offered but not taken" alongside the existing [AFFORDANCE] resolution, this becomes machine-detectable from production logs instead of requiring a human to read a 22-turn transcript. I think this is the highest-leverage item here, because it converts every future instance of this class from invisible to countable.

C-2. The read side may also be ignoring the karte. The seed wrote confident states across 22 skills including 三角関数 and 単位円, yet the recommendation said "next: fractions, decimals and integers" before AND after the session. Worth checking whether the recommender reads the karte at all, or reads something else. I did not investigate.

C-3. Recommending elementary fractions to a learner working at 数C matches a documented harmful pattern. Flagging as literature, not as my observation: TNTP/Zearn, over two million students, found that students sent back to remediate had a 44 percent chance of struggling on the next grade-level lesson versus 36 percent for those kept at grade level with prerequisites pulled in just-in-time. The tutor today actually did the good version - it kept the addition theorem as the destination and pulled in the unit circle and right triangles as needed. The map and the recommender did the bad version. This is relevant to how いまここ and おすすめ should be computed, and it does not conflict with axiom E - it supports E while criticising the current implementation.

C-4. The learner bounced off the map. Step 3: too many islands to count, could not find the addition theorem, "it will be faster to just ask the teacher directly". She then used the tutor as the navigation interface and never returned to the map until after the session. The map did not serve navigation for her at all.
